# Warning Shots: The AI Incident Index

> A live index of AI's dangers and breakthroughs as they land on real lives: every significant AI incident since 2023, scored 0-100 by a published formula and linked to its sources, with a headline page refreshed three times a day (6:37, 12:37 and 18:37 US Eastern).

Last refresh: Oct 26, 2026, 3:25 PM ET. 160 incidents scored. Corrections and retractions are logged publicly; retracted claims are labelled as such on every page.

## Start here
- [Front page: today's headlines](https://warningshots.ai/): the level of the day, the running story, three columns of headlines each linking to the original reporting
- [The Record](https://warningshots.ai/index/): every incident scored, charts, forecasts and their track record, and whether fixes held
- [The Wire](https://warningshots.ai/wire/): every report from the last three days, newest first
- [All incidents](https://warningshots.ai/i/): one page per incident, newest first
- [Did they fix it?](https://warningshots.ai/c/): report, response, claimed fix, independent check, current status
- [What AI can now do](https://warningshots.ai/m/): capability milestones graded from demonstration to real consequences
- [Live tracker: PHP2Shell: AI-found PHP flaws leak, trigger global shutdowns](https://warningshots.ai/php2shell/)
- [What to do: AI voice clone scam call: what to do right now](https://warningshots.ai/help/voice-clone-scam-call/): A crying voice that sounds like your child or parent, a crisis, a demand for money: it may be an AI voice clone. What to do in the next five minutes, how to check, how to report it, with real cases.
- [What to do: AI scam texts: how to spot them and what to do (2026)](https://warningshots.ai/help/ai-scam-texts/): Scam texts no longer have the typos that gave them away. The five most common text scams, the new AI-era warning signs, what to do if you clicked, and where to report it.


## Data
- [incidents.json](https://warningshots.ai/data/incidents.json) and [incidents.csv](https://warningshots.ai/data/incidents.csv): every incident with its five factor ratings, dates, summary and sources
- [forecasts.json](https://warningshots.ai/data/forecasts.json): dated forecasts with probabilities and resolution dates
- [RSS: the Wire and the brief](https://warningshots.ai/feed.xml), [RSS: new incident, case and milestone pages](https://warningshots.ai/feed-dispatches.xml)

## How scores work
Each incident is rated on Harm (0-5), Reach (0-5), Autonomy (0-4), Novelty (0-5) and Irreversibility (0-5). Harm score = 100 x (0.5 H/5 + 0.25 R/5 + 0.25 I/5); signal score = 100 x (0.6 A/4 + 0.4 N/5); severity = 0.55 x harm + 0.45 x signal. Tiers: under 20 Minor (WS-1), 20-39 Moderate (WS-2), 40-59 Serious (WS-3), 60-79 Severe (WS-4), 80+ Critical (WS-5). Proof is graded in three rungs that are never blurred: Tried (attempts logged), Proven (a test system actually broken into), Hit (a real victim confirmed).
